title: Broncos elevate S Taylor Rapp, DB Sean Fresch for Thursday night

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos elevate S Taylor Rapp, DB Sean Fresch for Thursday night
sources.description: The Broncos are dealing with several injuries in their defensive backfield, so they elevated a couple of players to help round out the secondary ahead of Thursday night's game against the Seahawks.
